analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to buy today after 3 consecutive sessions of waiting. RSI confirmed exit from oversold territory, moving from 45.7 to 58.3. MACD histogram continues to improve, rising from 302.7514 to 541.4466. A Higher Low pattern is forming, with the 5-day low at 32,655 KRW and the 20-day low at 31,975 KRW. Although volume is subdued at 0.50 times the 5-day average, the concurrent improvement in both RSI and MACD strengthens the buy signal.
